title: osrs-data-hub — Hub overview
description: Ingest, events, plugin, live, players, Discord verification, API, jobs, data rights and process health of an osrs-data-hub instance (web + worker).

list.name: job
list.label: Job
list.description: Scrape jobs of the hub processes (web, worker).

panels.title: Payloads by status
panels.description: Plugin ingest requests per second, by HTTP status returned.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of ingest requests answered 5xx and 4xx. The 5% line is the HubIngest5xxRate alert threshold.
Ingest requests per minute refused as unauthorized (401), rate limited (429) or unavailable (503).

panels.title: Ingest latency
panels.description: Ingest request processing time: p50, p95 and p99 over all requests.

panels.title: Ignored payloads
panels.description: Payloads accepted but ignored, per second, by reason.

panels.title: Events stored by type
panels.description: Events stored per second, stacked by event type.

panels.title: Duplicate events
panels.description: Events per second the hub already had (plugin resends); not stored again.

panels.title: Skipped sections & events
panels.description: Payload sections and malformed events dropped per second by lenient parsing.

panels.title: Requests by plugin version
panels.description: Plugin requests per X-Osrs-Exporter-Version. Counted over the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Plugin requests by version
panels.description: Plugin requests per second, by plugin version.

panels.title: Live connections
panels.description: Open live (SSE) connections right now.

panels.title: Live connections
panels.description: Open live (SSE) connections over time.

panels.title: Live streams refused
panels.description: Live (SSE) streams refused per minute by the per-user connection limit.

panels.title: Pairing attempts
panels.description: Pairing attempts per minute, by result.

panels.title: Open play sessions
panels.description: Players online: open play sessions as of the worker's last close-stale-sessions run.

panels.title: Open play sessions
panels.description: Open play sessions over time (updated by each close-stale-sessions run).

panels.title: Sessions timed out
panels.description: Play sessions per hour ended by the presence timeout (no clean logout, e.g. a crashed client).

panels.title: Checks by verdict
panels.description: Discord membership re-verifications in the preceding hour (rolling), by verdict. Runs are periodic, so per-second rates would only show spikes.

panels.title: Check failures by kind
panels.description: Membership checks that errored (not a 'not a member' verdict) in the preceding hour (rolling), by kind.

panels.title: Breaker trips
panels.description: Re-verification runs stopped by a circuit breaker (nobody offboarded). Counted over the dashboard's time range. Red when any: see the worker logs.

panels.title: Breaker trips by rule
panels.description: Circuit breaker trips in the preceding hour (rolling), by breaker rule.

panels.title: Offboarded users by reason
panels.description: Active users moved into the grace period, by reason (self_delete = Delete my data). Counted over the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Requests by group
panels.description: Public API (/api/v1) requests per second, by route group.

panels.title: Requests by status class
panels.description: Public API requests per second, by HTTP status class.

panels.title: 429s by limit
panels.description: Public API requests per minute refused 429, by which rate limit (key, snapshot, auth_ip).

panels.title: Failed key authentications
panels.description: Public API requests per minute refused 401, by why the API key failed.

panels.title: p95 latency by group
panels.description: 95th percentile public API processing time, by route group.

panels.title: Job duration
panels.description: Worker job run time, p50 and p95 per job over the preceding hour (rolling); jobs run periodically.

panels.title: Job runs by result
panels.description: Worker job runs in the preceding hour (rolling), by job and result.

panels.title: Job failures
panels.description: Failed worker job runs, all jobs. Counted over the dashboard's time range. Red when any.

panels.title: Time since last success
panels.description: Time since each worker job last succeeded. Turns red at the HubJobStale alert limit for that job. A job appears only once it has succeeded since the worker started.

panels.title: Data exports by result
panels.description: Download my data requests by result. Counted over the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Delete my data
panels.description: Users who used Delete my data (offboarded with reason self_delete). Counted over the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Grace expiries
panels.description: Users deleted when their grace period ended. Counted over the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Accounts deleted by cause
panels.description: OSRS accounts deleted with their data, by cause (grace_expiry, orphan_purge). Counted over the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Targets
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape each hub process (web, worker) right now. Lists jobs that exported hub metrics in the last week.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since each hub process started.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Process restarts (changes of the start time) per hub process. Counted over the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Resident memory
panels.description: Resident memory (RSS) per hub process.

panels.title: Event-loop lag p99
panels.description: Node.js event-loop delay, 99th percentile, per hub process. Sustained high values mean the process is CPU-bound or blocked.
